claims.claim: Plastic drum for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Photos show blue plastic drums with hazard-diamond labels suggesting prior chemical/industrial contents; no interior shots or label text confirm food-grade or universal liquid-safe status.

risks.risk: Drums may have held hazardous or chemical contents previously (residue, odor, contamination), making them unsafe for food or general liquid storage.
risks.proof: Close-up photo/video of interior of each drum and readable text on the hazard-diamond labels.
risks.if_unproven: price as industrial-grade/non-food-safe drums, not general-purpose liquid storage

risks.risk: Capacity/volume of drums unknown, directly affecting unit value.
risks.proof: Photo showing stamped liter capacity on drum body or a tape-measure shot of dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: price at the smallest common capacity assumption

risks.risk: Unknown number of drums included in the sale lot.
risks.proof: A count confirmation photo or seller itemized list matching a wide shot.
risks.if_unproven: price as single-unit listing unless count is confirmed

risks.risk: Structural damage (cracks, dents) not visible from current angles.
risks.proof: Multiple-angle photos including base, rim, and bung closures.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged bungs/lids/seals affecting usability for liquid storage.
risks.proof: Close-up of bung/lid area per drum.
risks.if_unproven: price as missing-seal condition, requiring replacement

risks.risk: Age/wear reducing plastic integrity (UV degradation, brittleness).
risks.proof: Manufacture date stamp photo if present on drum base.
risks.if_unproven: price as used/aged stock, not new

proof_requests: Close-up interior shot of at least one drum showing residue/cleanliness
Readable photo of the hazard-diamond label and any printed text
Photo showing stamped capacity/volume on the drum
Wide shot showing exact count of drums for sale
Any manufacture date stamp if visible
response.reason: The witness confirms these are generic used blue plastic storage drums of unknown grade, count, and condition, so they can be priced at worst case (non-food-grade, unverified capacity, possible residue) pending further proof.
